adjudication.rationale: In the newly added scheduled job `Jobs::PollFeed` the diff explicitly sets `sidekiq_options retry: false` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). That does mean transient errors (e.g., network/open-uri failure, RSS parse errors) will not be retried by Sidekiq and this particular scheduled execution will be dropped. However, the diff doesn’t prove this causes incorrectness/data loss because the job is scheduled hourly (`recurrence { hourly }`) and the polling implementation re-reads the whole feed each run (`rss.items.each`) without a “last seen” cursor, so a later successful run could still import/update the same items. Thus it’s a concrete reliability/operational concern grounded in the diff, but not a verifiable defect from the diff alone.
